data.name: Coin Dynasty
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to 'Coin Dynasty'! Here, every coin insertion drives history, and every ancient coin carries the weight of civilization, a world of ancient coins resurrected with modern technology. We are not only committed to restoring history, but also to presenting the texture and sound of each coin spanning thousands of years.

Unreal Engine 5 Driver: With top-notch graphics technology, we have endowed each ancient coin with astonishing details. The rust on the coins, the scratches on the inscriptions, and the wear and tear on the metal all come to life vividly under high-definition materials and dynamic lighting.

High precision physical modeling: All coins in the game are modeled in high standard 3D with reference to reality, strictly following the shapes, sizes, and textual features of each dynasty, striving to achieve the most realistic visual reproduction in the digital world.

Immersive sound effect system: We have recorded and simulated the collision, rolling, and falling sound effects of coins made of different materials (copper, iron, silver) and in different states (brand new, corroded, damaged). Every push is an auditory feast written by real spectrograms.

【 Core gameplay: Triple fun fusion 】

Classic coin pusher operation: Input tokens and use a pusher to push down the mountain of ancient coins. Enjoy the instant decompression sensation of coin collisions, chain drops, and ultimately falling into the prize pool.

Deep collection of historical coins: Each coin featured in the game is designed strictly based on the real currency of China throughout history. From pre Qin knife coins and cloth coins, to Han Wuzhu, Tang Kaiyuan, Song Yushu coins, and even Ming Qing Tongbao. Every time you push, you may discover rare treasures.

Strategic dynastic management (national power system): The coins you collect are not only collectibles, but also resources for developing "national power". Consume them to upgrade your 'Dynasty Institution':

Department of Works: Upgrade the promotion efforts, expand the prize pool capacity, and increase physical benefits.

Household Department: Increase the basic value of coins and increase offline automatic income.

Ministry of Rites: Increase the probability of rare and special coins appearing, unlock historical knowledge encyclopedia.
